pkgmetadata.longdescription: parakeet.cpp is a C++17/ggml inference port of NVIDIA NeMo Parakeet ASR (CTC, RNNT, TDT and hybrid TDT-CTC heads), with cache-aware streaming + EOU decoding and a flat C-API (libparakeet.so) for FFI/dlopen integration. The GGML model files are converted from NeMo checkpoints with the bundled Python scripts and are not part of the package.

use.flag: Sound-event detection through the vendored ced.cpp
Build the extra example binaries (diarize, sound-window-eval) besides parakeet-cli
Link against sci-ml/ggml instead of building the vendored ggml submodule
Build the ggml Vulkan backend into the vendored ggml (only used without system-ggml; the system ggml's backends are chosen by its own USE flags)
